source_conditions: Differentiate production and expanded nonproduction scope; keep lifecycle/change/access links; annual classification review; authorization, custody and protection during storage/transfer; tightly bounded removable-media use.
design_comparison: Inventory and disposal drafts cover lifecycle intent but omit all four C5 data categories, standby hardware, commissioning checks and the specific removable-media restrictions.
corrective_design: Extend asset records with hardware/software relationships, data protection needs including authenticity, access lists, approved commissioning and movement evidence. Document basic/sharpened scope and test each applicable exception.

source_conditions: Operate the referenced continuity management approach; assign management responsibility; review BIA/plans and test at least annually and after significant change, involving affected customers/third parties.
design_comparison: Reno/Boise exercises are candidate support; a recovery drill does not establish the referenced management system or customer involvement.
corrective_design: Reconcile ISO22301/BSI200-4 requirements, scope and management responsibilities; retain annual/change-triggered schedules, customer/provider involvement and plan updates. Do not infer that certification itself is mandatory from the basic criterion.

source_conditions: Maintain a multi-year audit programme; apply operating safeguards; annual internal audits and management review; impartiality outside the audited reporting line or supported alternative. Sharpened programme specifies three years.
design_comparison: Risk-based audit and meeting procedures omit explicit minimum intervals, safe access restrictions and evidence of reporting-line independence.
corrective_design: Add source-specific cadence and independence checks, audit access/test safeguards, relevant authority and customer audit rights when selected. Distinguish management review from independent audit.

source_conditions: Protect network boundaries and administrative/workload orchestration paths; separate tenants; annually review topology/configuration and significant changes; review service/port justification.
design_comparison: Generic network baseline and MFA do not specify every trust boundary, permitted flow or topology reconciliation.
corrective_design: Create a flow/zone/administrative-plane matrix; test cross-tenant and cross-network denials, detection/SIEM linkage and configuration drift. Keep additional encrypted logical separation and sharpened redundant gateways distinct.

source_conditions: Govern the full key lifecycle, supplier/customer key access, annual and incident-triggered cryptographic review, customer change notifications and current approved cryptographic guidance. Additional PQC strategy is separate.
design_comparison: The baseline crypto supplement omits several lifecycle states, customer access agreements, the HSM continuity choice and explicit review/notification duties.
corrective_design: Implement key-state and custody records, certificate/provisioning verification, restricted compromised/expired-key uses, archival and recovery tests, customer access/change notices and separate PQC planning if selected.

source_conditions: Secure lifecycle requirements and provider access minimization; cumulative change risks; security-feature inputs/outputs/errors; customer approval and anonymization before test use; software composition and supplier control.
design_comparison: Peer review and release attribution omit security-feature test completeness, cumulative change risk, composition lists and explicit customer-data test rules.
corrective_design: Add a security-feature specification/test matrix, combined-change assessment, outsourced acceptance evidence, version/dependency inventory and test-data approval/anonymization checks. Preserve emergency deviations and protect rollback data.

source_conditions: Risk-proportionate lawful screening and higher-risk role reassessment; pre-access terms/acknowledgment; learning outcomes; documented disciplinary measures; annual confidentiality review; controlled remote work.
design_comparison: Hiring/training drafts cover broad process but omit several timing, learning-outcome, ongoing confidentiality and remote-equipment conditions.
corrective_design: Reconcile all internal/external personnel, assess role changes and effectiveness of training, track continuing obligations and updated agreements, and test remote equipment/access enforcement. Sharpened annual training is separate from basic regular role-based training.

source_conditions: Provider identity lifecycle includes fixed adjustment and review-remediation limits, orphan resources, customer-data access notice, privileged monitoring and production MFA including automated access.
design_comparison: Generic timely revocation and risk-based authentication omit explicit clocks, production workload interpretation and customer access-notice facts.
corrective_design: Add exact source-bound timing rules and identity populations, customer consent/notification paths, supervised support and compromised-identity fallback. Keep provider and customer authentication rules and basic/sharpened scopes separate.

source_conditions: Require qualified lawful-basis assessment, customer notification with source exceptions, scoped disclosure, inseparable-data protection and service-specific technical transparency.
design_comparison: Contract review is not a government-request operating process.
corrective_design: Use a request/disclosure register with authorization, minimization tests, notice decisions and documented technical means; preserve the distinction between basic processing and additional activity monitoring.

source_conditions: ISMS conformity and complete cloud scope, shared responsibility, conflicting duties, threat intelligence, conditional German public-sector contacts, repeatable risk process and annual/change reviews.
design_comparison: Reference scope and broad ERM routes omit an actual ISMS/SSRM and the explicit annual/risk-owner and external communication conditions.
corrective_design: Document scoped processes, SSRM, conflicts/compensation, threat-to-risk linkage and risk-owner decisions. Basic ISMS conformity does not itself require the sharpened certification evidence.

source_conditions: Address service capacity, malware update cadence, backups and protected restores, derived/account data purposes, SIEM capabilities, crash data, vulnerability clocks/testing, tenant separation and conditional confidential computing/container operation.
design_comparison: Broad security and recovery procedures omit numerous explicit service capabilities, data classes, clocks and test populations.
corrective_design: Use the detailed findings for timing and capabilities; add data-specific log/backup/crash handling, correlated alerts, tenant-layer tests and customer information. Do not equate a periodic scanner or retained logs with the full operational criteria.

source_conditions: Provide secure interoperable interfaces and usable extraction, defined customer exit terms and documented nonrecoverable deletion with bounded retention exceptions.
design_comparison: Supplier exit and internal retention rules do not establish customer-facing extraction or proof of customer-data deletion.
corrective_design: Implement and test customer export and deletion workflows, authenticated interfaces, integrity checks, agreed formats/windows and evidence accessible to the customer; additional federation and derived-data export remain separate.

source_conditions: Meet actual sensitive/public zones, provider physical CSOCs, two-site basic redundancy, physical access/monitoring, intrusion/fire criteria, utilities and environmental monitoring; sharpened redundancy exceeds two locations.
design_comparison: Two proposed site names and broad physical/environment supplements do not establish facilities capability, numeric criteria or verified provider duties.
corrective_design: Obtain site-specific design/test evidence and CSOC coverage; compare exact physical thresholds and allowed alternatives, access factors and stale access, utility maintenance and environmental limits. Treat a third-site requirement as an architecture/selection decision.

source_conditions: Provide version-specific secure-use guidance/CUECs, vulnerability information, customer audit logs, enforceable authentication/roles/session controls, safe SDN/images where offered and region commitments.
design_comparison: Corporate IAM and support procedures do not prove customer product functionality.
corrective_design: Build a customer capability matrix linked to service version, interface and tests; include distinct password/reset bounds, tenant administration, security logs, supplier vulnerability intake, image/SDN validation and regional constraints.

source_conditions: Operate response team/plans, annual plan review, classification/root cause, qualified help, secure evidence and customer solution/incident communication; protect good-faith false reports.
design_comparison: Generic incident chronology and closure omit explicit customer acknowledgments, a safe reporting assurance and maintained classification/learning knowledge.
corrective_design: Add communication/acknowledgment terms, reporting duties, protected false reports, evidence custody and a linked incident knowledge base. Keep additional annual simulations/forensic team choices separate.

source_conditions: Standardize policy structure and communication; approve before effect; review annually/after significant change; consider aggregated exception risk; no exception may create an applicable C5 deviation.
design_comparison: Generic expiring waivers could conceal a framework deviation and omit aggregate risk.
corrective_design: Link policy review calendars to C5 minima; review combined exceptions and flag any conflict with an applicable criterion as unresolved deviation rather than waived compliance.

source_conditions: Assess suppliers before use and annually, obtain customer processing authority, track jurisdictions/locations/subcontractors, verify actual CSOCs, communicate adverse changes, govern exits and supplier-component exchanges.
design_comparison: Tiered diligence and contract clauses omit customer preauthorization, explicit CSOC verification and each-transfer supplier component control.
corrective_design: Reconcile supplier/subcontractor data paths and customer authorizations, annual directory/risk/confidentiality reviews, scoped independent evidence or audit rights, high-dependency exit triggers and logged transfer authorization.
